description: This file defines various parameter classes and types used in FastAPI for handling request parameters, including query, path, header, cookie, body, form, and file parameters, as well as dependency and security classes.

classes.name: ParamTypes
classes.description: Enumeration of parameter locations in HTTP requests (query, header, path, cookie).

classes.name: Param
classes.description: Class representing a request parameter with various validation and serialization options.

classes.name: Path
classes.description: Subclass of Param for path parameters, which cannot have default values.

classes.name: Query
classes.description: Subclass of Param for query parameters.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Subclass of Param for header parameters, with underscore conversion option.

classes.name: Cookie
classes.description: Subclass of Param for cookie parameters.

classes.name: Body
classes.description: Class representing request body parameters, with media type and embedding options.

classes.name: Form
classes.description: Subclass of Body for form data with media type 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Subclass of Form for file uploads with media type 'multipart/form-data'.

classes.name: Depends
classes.description: Class for dependency injection, marked as frozen dataclass.

classes.name: Security
classes.description: Subclass of Depends for security dependencies, with scope and scopes.

methods.name: Param.__init__
methods.description: Constructor for Param class, initializes parameter with validation, alias, description, and other options.

methods.name: Path.__init__
methods.description: Constructor for Path parameters, enforces no default value.

methods.name: Header.__init__
methods.description: Constructor for Header parameters, with underscore conversion option.

methods.name: Body.__init__
methods.description: Constructor for Body parameters, with media type and embedding options.

methods.name: Form.__init__
methods.description: Constructor for Form parameters, with media type 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'.

methods.name: File.__init__
methods.description: Constructor for File parameters, with media type 'multipart/form-data'.

methods.name: Depends
methods.description: Constructor for dependency injection, immutable dataclass.

methods.name: Security
methods.description: Constructor for security dependencies, immutable dataclass with scopes.
